text: だって　あたし　ものまね　しゅみ　なんだ　もん！

structure.jp: ものまね　しゅみ　なんだ　もん！
structure.en: Mimic is my hobby, that's why!

patterns.name: 〜もん
patterns.explanation: もん at the end gives a reason in a childish, excuse-making way, often paired with だって. なんだ　もん = 'because it is, so there'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ and gives an explaining tone; after a thing word it becomes なんだ. しゅみ　なんだ = 'it's my hobby, you see'.
